speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Ministry will implement mandatory installation of water coolers in areas of high footfall for drinking water to be readily available so as to promote better health.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: I am wondering if these can also be extended to other areas of high footfall that are not those specified by her, which is tourist attractions and other areas where the Government could have some influence to have those water coolers installed.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: And secondly, is there any impediment to expanding this more quickly given that we do face a problem in terms of cultivating healthier habits amongst Singaporeans as an important national issue?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: I think better hydration would help with that.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: And this conversation I think has been going on for some time and various Members and others in the public have called for more water coolers.
